Transparent Entertainment Studio | Multiple Executive Roles | REMOTE

We are building the world's first transparent entertainment studio - revolutionizing how entertainment is created, funded, and shared with the world. Looking to build our founding executive team.

Open Positions (all 100% REMOTE):

• Chief Financial Officer (CFO) - Lead all financial operations including fundraising, investor relations, budgeting, and financial planning. 10+ years finance leadership experience required.

• Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) - Drive brand strategy, audience development, and marketing campaigns. 10+ years marketing leadership experience required.

• Chief Technology Officer (CTO) - Lead technology strategy, platform development, and engineering teams. 10+ years technology leadership experience required.

• Chief Operating Officer (COO) - Oversee daily operations, scale processes, and drive operational excellence. 10+ years operations leadership experience required.

• Executive Assistant to CEO - Support the CEO with calendar management, communications, and strategic projects. 3+ years executive assistant experience required.

This is a unique opportunity to join a founding team and shape the future of entertainment from the ground up.

To apply: Send your resume and cover letter to gratwickdocuments@gmail.com
